landing.descentHeading: Read Pandora as a specimen, not a movie
landing.descentBody: Each chapter takes one strange thing about Pandora as bait, then leads you to a real scientific idea - biology, planetary science, physics - woven in subtly rather than lectured.
landing.descentNote: Four classification tiers - Canon, Inference, Speculation, Real science - always tell you where you stand between fact and imagination.

landing.closingBody: Start with the first specimen and follow the bait down into real biology, planetary science, and physics — one strange, glowing thing at a time.
